column1: # post-transfer-admissions.tsv — LeanProofs/ paths admitted after the ratified
# check-v15-integration.py freezes every LeanProofs/ path against the transfer
# commit and excludes exactly the paths listed here. That freeze is the repo's
# broad change-scope protection: an unintended edit to any *other* public Lean
# source fails it, which no other gate catches (custody checks classification,
# target ownership checks the import graph, footprint gates check named
# receipts, and per-file digests cover only their own release's sources).
# A release admitting new public Lean sources registers them here — one row per
# path — instead of editing the checker. Registering a path only exempts it from
# the freeze; it does not classify, target-own, or footprint it. Those remain
# separate gates. Deleting a row re-freezes that path against the baseline.
